automated.note: Configured pattern diagnostic only; not an authorship detector. Ties include no-change and non-lexical cases.

targeted_reaudit_after_fix.note: Independent evaluator confirmed preservation of numbers, terminology, modality, exact site/institution scope, and sample limits. The full 36-case set was not rescored, so no extrapolated post-fix mean is reported.

limitations: The benchmark is synthetic and intentionally stresses known language failure modes.
The 36-case blind review used one independent evaluator; inter-rater reliability is not available.
Results do not estimate AI authorship or performance on unobserved disciplines.
Future releases must add author-owned and pre-LLM holdout prose without replacing this frozen set.
